items.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
items.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

items.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
items.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

items.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
items.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

items.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
items.summary: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

items.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots
items.summary: Serve Robotics announced alonsgside its third-quarter earnings that it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services to offer customers its connectivity and data tools.

items.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
items.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

items.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
items.summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

items.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
items.summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

items.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
items.summary: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass hacks.

items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027

items.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
items.summary: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.

items.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
items.summary: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

items.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
items.summary: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

items.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
items.summary: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

items.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
items.summary: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

items.title: Bluesky hit peak usage for the year on election night
items.summary: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider said posts and likes doubled during to the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

items.title: Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
items.summary: Zipline raised $1.5 billion and ramped up its partnership with Walmart.

items.title: TikTok quietly launches a stand-alone TikTok Shop app
items.summary: The app will offer personalized product recommendations, shopping through livestreams and short-form videos, app-exclusive deals, in-app checkout, order tracking, and customer support.

items.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
items.summary: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.
